subject.title: feat(ui): gateway browser panel with annotate-to-prompt and element inspect in the web Control UI

question: Should the web Control UI adopt this first-class gateway browser panel and annotation workflow as a supported core UI surface after the interaction defects are fixed?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and linked feature issue show that landing this large new operator surface needs explicit product ownership beyond mechanical correctness.

options.title: Adopt after repairs
options.body: Accept the feature direction after the three interaction defects and final proof gate are resolved.

options.title: Narrow the initial surface
options.body: Ship browser viewing and freehand annotation while deferring element inspection or coordinate interaction.

options.title: Retain native-only browsing
options.body: Decline the web panel and keep the existing macOS dashboard browser as the supported surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction after the three interaction defects and final proof gate are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the native browser and Control UI product surfaces involved in the decision.
